evidence.sourceText: Bache lor of Integrated Engineering with H onours

Programme Educational Objectives: produce engineers who lead engineering practices; engineers who provide integrated and sustainable solutions for society; and engineers who become technopreneurs in engineering-based business ventures. Programme Learning Outcomes include applying mathematics, natural science, computing and engineering fundamentals to integrated engineering problems; identifying, formulating and analysing complex integrated engineering problems; designing innovative solutions; conducting investigations; applying latest techniques and IT tools; and evaluating sustainable development impacts.

Business: Aircraft Health System; Automation in Telco; Interface Management; Supply Chain Enterprise; Business Solution Developer; Business Enablement; Business Development; Business & Corporate Banking. Engineering & Technology: Software + IT Engineer; Product Owner; Project Developer; Process Engineer; Application Engineer; Project and System Engineer; Delivery Manager; Workshop/Line Maintenance; Plant Operations. ESG: ESG; Continuous Improvement Specialist.

The Bachelor of Integrated Engineering programme prepares students for a lifetime of growth through employment promise with industry partners, deep industry exposure as early as Year 1, an interdisciplinary curriculum focused on the future of work, enrichment through industry exposure, attachments and exchanges, and a digitally enabled student life.
